title.en: One allergy becomes two constraints for a grocer and one for a planner

goal.en: The allergy facet derives to allergen_block and labeling_required. A grocer may receive both, a planner only the block, a delivery service neither. The answer names the facet id, never the allergen or the child.

note.en: The allergy facet alone, for a grocer: a block and a labelling requirement.
For a planner: the block only; labelling is not in the planner's allow-list.
For a delivery service: nothing; the facet is withheld as not allowed for the role.
derivedFrom carries the facet id. The allergen itself goes in the DerivedConstraint's value (examples/household/constraints-planner-allergen.json); the subject never does.

outcome.en: You know how an allergy reaches a shop as a block and a label and reaches a planner as a block only; Core rule 6.7 then refuses any recipe that contains a blocked allergen. Next: 090 reads the public registry.
